question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The incorrectly spelt word is: **Aristocrate** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is "**aristocrat**". • The incorrect spelling has an extra "**e**" at the end. • "**Aristocrat**" refers to a member of a ruling class or nobility, while "aristocracy" refers to a government or society ruled by such a class. (शासक वर्ग या कुलीन वर्ग का सदस्य) • **For example**: *The elegant ball was attended by many aristocrats from high society.* • Other options in the question are correctly spelt words. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Advertise **means to promote or publicize a product or service. (किसी उत्पाद या सेवा का प्रचार या प्रचार करना) • **Occurrence **means an event or incident. (कोई घटना या प्रसंग) • **Preference **means a choice or liking for one thing over another. (एक चीज़ को दूसरी चीज़ से ज़्यादा पसंद करना या पसंद करना) 32:T96b, The correct answer is: "**you since last year**"
